entries.097c74d56180921b: A holding company centered on the purchase and sale of used items such as branded goods, jewelry and watches, which also handles tire and wheel sales and real estate leasing.
entries.4ffffd6167f97eaa: This is a reportable segment that manages the leasing of stores and leases the key stores of group companies to group companies.
entries.5635f02aa941e0d6: This is a reportable segment that conducts purchasing, procurement, sales (stores and EC), brokerage and auction operations for used items, mainly jewelry and precious metals, watches, bags and fashion goods.
entries.5bbff594d8533d1c: This is a reportable segment that plans, researches and develops, manufactures, sells and provides services for passenger car tires and wheels, and automotive accessories and parts. Kurafuto Co., Ltd. operates tire and wheel specialty stores, and Auto Parts Japan Co., Ltd. operates 'U-ICHIBAN', a specialty store for the sale and purchase of used tires and wheels. Four by Four Engineering Service Co., Ltd. plans, researches and develops, manufactures and sells original wheels. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥6,523 million.
entries.c22ab426b724c41f: This is a reportable segment that manages the leasing of stores and leases the key stores of group companies to group companies. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥365 million, most of which is intersegment internal sales from leases to group companies.
entries.e1f12eda2a99075a: This is a reportable segment that plans, researches and develops, manufactures, sells and provides services for passenger car tires and wheels, and automotive accessories and parts.
entries.e6515115df7a176a: This is a reportable segment that conducts purchasing, procurement, sales (stores and EC), brokerage and auction operations for used items, mainly jewelry and precious metals, watches, bags and fashion goods. In Japan, Komehyo Co., Ltd., K-Brand Off Co., Ltd., R-K Enterprise Co., Ltd. and others purchase goods from general customers (individual purchases) and from corporations handling used goods, and sell them through stores and EC. Overseas, subsidiaries in Hong Kong, China, Taiwan, Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, the United States and others sell used goods, and iShopShops, Inc. in the United States operates a live commerce platform. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥215,146 million, the largest of the 3 reportable segments.
